info.title: AI7 UAE Verification API
info.description: AI7 UAE verification APIs for UAE trade licences, international bank accounts, comprehensive entity screening, and multilingual adverse media. Responses are JSON.

post.description: Verifies a UAE trade licence issued by any emirate or free zone.

requestBody.description: At least one of license_number, licence_number, company_name, or license_document is required.

400.description: The request format or parameters are invalid.

example.error: A required variable is missing or in the wrong format.

401.description: The API key is missing or invalid.

example.error: API key is missing or incorrect.

422.description: An uploaded document is invalid or could not be recognised.

example.error: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

post.description: Verifies international bank and account-owner details. AI7 handles the private encrypted relay internally.

200.description: Verification completed, including match and no-record results.

400.description: The request format or parameters are invalid.

401.description: The AI7 API key is missing or invalid.

post.description: Searches people, organizations, aircraft, vessels, and goods across PEP, sanctions, watchlists, AML, adverse media, and specialist risk datasets.

400.description: The request or search-type combination is invalid.

401.description: The AI7 API key is missing or invalid.

500.description: The screening service is temporarily unavailable.

post.summary: Screen an individual or business for adverse media
post.description: Searches current and archived global news plus open-web indexes in up to five languages, resolves the requested entity, applies deterministic and bounded AI review, and returns evidence for human review. Every synchronous result includes an automatically generated, permanently retained PDF audit report; customer_logo_url is the only report-specific input.

202.description: Deep research was durably queued. The signed final result will be delivered to the supplied callback URL. Consumers must inspect status, summary.decision_eligible, and coverage before use.

401.description: The AI7 API key is missing or invalid.

502.description: The media index is temporarily unavailable.

503.description: The permanent PDF report service is temporarily unavailable.

get.summary: Download a permanent adverse-media audit report
get.description: Downloads a permanently retained PDF without an API key. The UUID is an unguessable capability identifier; anyone with the URL can download the report.

200.description: The PDF report identified by the capability URL.

404.description: No report has that capability ID.

503.description: The report store is temporarily unavailable.

ApiKey.description: Use your AI7 UAE API key as a Bearer token.

company_name.title: Company name
company_name.description: Company name in English or Arabic.

authorising_body.title: Authorising body
authorising_body.description: The authority that issued the trade licence.

license_document.description: Raw base64 or a data URI; a name parameter may be included in the data URI.

transID.description: Unique transaction ID supplied by the client.

docType.description: Always 610. AI7 enforces this value before forwarding the request.

country.description: Associated country. This key is required; use an empty string when unknown.

gender.description: Known gender. This key is required; use an empty string when unknown.

dob.description: Known date of birth in yyyy/MM/dd format. This key is required; use an empty string when unknown.

watchlist_list_ids.description: Watchlist list IDs used to filter data.

sanction_list_ids.description: Sanctions list IDs used to filter data.

search_type.description: Datasets to search. APC must be used alone. ER-APC must be combined with pep, sanction, or watchlist.

fields_weightage.description: Weights for name, alias, country, dob, address, gender, and identifier. Values must total 1. The structured array is the current request format; the string form remains represented for contract compatibility.

apc_duration.description: Number of past days to retrieve. Required for APC-only searches.

percentage_of_shareholding.description: Capture the ownership percentage that an organization holds in other organization

EntitySearchResponse.description: Exact pass-through response. Fields vary with selected checks; all documented fields and any additional dataset-specific fields are preserved.

high_risk_threshold_percent.description: Results at or above this percentage are assigned to the High Risk band. This value must not be lower than review_threshold_percent.

review_threshold_percent.description: Results from this percentage up to the High Risk boundary require Review. Lower scores are assigned to the Safe band. This value must not exceed high_risk_threshold_percent.

risk_threshold.description: Backward-compatible decimal alias for review_threshold_percent. review_threshold_percent takes precedence when both are supplied.

search_plus.description: Reserves bounded query capacity for explicit site-restricted searches across selected high-value publishers, prioritising requested countries, and consolidates those results with standard evidence. coverage.search_plus lists successfully screened and incomplete publisher batches. The search is provider-index based, not a direct publisher crawl.

deep_research.description: Enables asynchronous screening and optional signed callback delivery.

callback_url.description: Optional public HTTPS callback URL. Accepted only when deep_research is true. Receives the final completed or explicitly partial result.

customer_logo_url.description: Optional public HTTPS PNG or JPEG used on the automatically generated PDF report.

search_plus_match.description: True when the evidence URL belongs to the approved Search+ publisher catalog.

review_required.description: True when the retained result is in the Review or High Risk band.

download_url.description: Absolute public capability URL for the permanently stored PDF report. Anyone with the unguessable URL can download it without an API key.

signing_secret.description: One-time secret used to verify the HMAC-SHA256 callback signature.
